embeds.title: 🔴 Over 320 NPM Packages Hit by Fresh Mini Shai-Hulud Supply Chain Attack
embeds.description:
**Actor:** TeamPCP
Security researchers report a fresh Mini Shai-Hulud supply chain attack compromising over 320 NPM packages, GitHub Actions, and a VS Code extension. The compromised NPM maintainer account 'atool' was used to publish malicious versions of popular packages including timeago.js and echarts-for-react. According to Socket, the campaign spans 1,055 versions across 502 unique packages (1,048 NPM versions across 498 packages, 6 PyPI entries, and 1 Composer entry). The malicious payloads extract CI/CD secrets from GitHub Actions runner memory, harvest credentials from over 130 file paths covering AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, HashiCorp Vault, cryptocurrency wallets, and developer tools, then exfiltrate data through GitHub repositories and fallback servers. Researchers attribute the attack to the hacking group TeamPCP. Microsoft's Durabletask Python SDK and the GitHub Action actions-cool/issues-helper were also compromised.
